acceptanceCriteria: corvint affected on a change to cmd/corvint-web-flows selects tools/web-flows/test/e2e.mjs or reports an explicit unknown for it, with a test.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator.

Found in the V1-0252 lane (branch claude/v1-0252-1008). tools/web-flows/test/e2e.mjs builds and drives cmd/corvint-web-flows, but corvint affected has no edge from the Go package to that Node test, so a change to the Go command did not select it; the lane ran script/web-flows-gate by hand. Expected: a declared or derived edge selects the Node e2e test when its driven Go command changes, or the plan reports the gap as an unknown.
title: affected: a Node test that drives a Go binary is not selected when the Go command changes
